Everything you need to know before joining AWS Student Community Day Jammu.

What is AWS Student Community Day Jammu?

It is a one-day, student-led AWS community conference featuring multiple topics, sessions and speakers, with practical learning and community experiences.

When and where is the event?

Friday, 20 November 2026, beginning at 09:00 AM IST at Aryabhatt Block Auditorium and R1–R2, Central University of Jammu.

Who can attend?

The event welcomes students, educators, community builders and learners interested in cloud technology. Capacity is limited, so registration is required.

How do I register?

Register using the official AWS Student Builder Group at Central University of Jammu Meetup event linked throughout this website.

Do I need prior AWS experience?

No. The programme is designed for learners at different stages, from students beginning their cloud journey to experienced builders.

What should I bring?

Bring your registration confirmation, a valid institutional identity card, a notebook and, where requested for a hands-on activity, your laptop and charger.

Will the agenda and speakers change?

Exact session titles, speakers, breaks and room assignments may be refined as confirmations are completed. The website will show the latest published information.

Who should I contact for help?

Email contact.aws.sbg.cujammu@gmail.com for registration or event-related questions.
